assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md header states 'Project: TC' and 'Vulnerability issue type ID: 10024'. All three JQL queries use 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024': Query 1 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)', Query 2 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New', Query 3 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, ON_QA)'.

assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md contains three labeled queries: Query 1 'labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)' for untriaged, Query 2 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New' for triaged-but-new, Query 3 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, ON_QA)' for Ready for QA candidates.

assertion_results.text: Results are grouped into three clearly separated lists: Untriaged issues, Triaged but still New issues, and Ready for QA issues
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md has three separate sections with headers and horizontal rules: '## Query 1: Untriaged Issues (primary list)' with 4 results, '## Query 2: Triaged but still New (stale issues)' with 1 result, '## Query 3: Ready for QA' with candidates and exclusions.

assertion_results.text: Each listed issue shows: issue key, status, CVE ID (from labels), summary, and created date
assertion_results.evidence: In discovery-listing.md, Query 1 issues are grouped by status sections (### Status: In Progress, ### Status: New) with table columns: Issue (key), CVE ID, Summary, Created. Query 2 table shows Issue, CVE ID, Summary, Created (all New status). Query 3 tables show Issue, Status, CVE, Summary, Created. All five data points (key, status, CVE ID, summary, created) are present for each issue.

assertion_results.text: Status-aware handling: New issues (TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004) are presented for full triage, while the In Progress issue (TC-9003) triggers a warning about active work
assertion_results.evidence: status-handling.md shows: TC-9001 (New) 'Handling: Proceed with full triage (default path)', TC-9002 (New) 'Handling: Proceed with full triage (default path)', TC-9004 (New) 'Handling: Proceed with full triage (default path)'. TC-9003 (In Progress) 'Handling: Warn — issue may be actively worked on' with warning 'This issue is already in In Progress. It may be actively worked on.'

assertion_results.text: Ready for QA filtering: TC-9020 appears in Ready for QA (all linked Tasks Done/Closed), TC-9023 is excluded (TC-9025 still In Progress), TC-9026 is excluded (no Depend links)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md shows TC-9020 under '### Ready for QA' with 'Remediation Tasks: TC-9021 (Done), TC-9022 (Closed)'. Under '### Excluded from Ready for QA': TC-9023 with reason 'TC-9025 still In Progress (remediation in progress)' and TC-9026 with reason 'No linked Tasks with type Depend (no remediation to verify)'.
